title: advice
description: Closed result of the advisor role: the options for one problem (a blocking question, red checks that stay red, a rejected finding), the one it recommends, and whether the owner must decide. Advice is a recommendation; the conductor applies it only when needs_owner is false and the category is not held by orch.advisor.human_gate.

problem_ref.description: The problem advised on, as the prompt named it: question:<id>@<revision>, checks:<round> or findings:<review round>.

options.description: The ways to go on, at least one; a question with options keeps their ids.

id.description: Option id, unique in the advice.

sources.description: URLs or repository paths the advice rests on; empty when it rests on the evidence given.

needs_owner.description: True when only the owner can decide: the conductor then queues the problem with the advice.

category.description: What kind of decision the advice touches; a category held by orch.advisor.human_gate (security, destructive, public-api, scope-expansion by default) is never applied without the owner.
